title: Test when a skill should not activate
text: Every’s companion workflow notes recommend writing evaluation cases before relying on long-running agents, including situations that should not trigger the skill. The retained artifact is not just a better prompt but trigger rules, realistic cases and reusable lessons from verified failures.
qualification: Companion notes point to another Every article; that linked original was not independently opened here.
